scope: Mocked chrome.* APIs; real panel markup and CSS in Chromium

results.test: floating button mounts, shows the 5-hour usage ring and marks the page so the old launcher hides
first-run hint appears once and is remembered when dismissed
Alt+T is ignored while typing in an input
Alt+T opens the panel on the tab that fits the page (油门 on a video page)
tabs are keyboard-navigable (arrows, roving tabindex, aria-controls)
油门 tab: switch and segmented control write settings and re-render live
首页 tab: turning on 无限下滑 reveals batch size and speed controls
刹车 tab: usage meters and presets apply and highlight
unrelated storage changes patch the panel in place instead of rebuilding it
with the self-discipline lock on, loosening presets are deferred and listed with an undo button
Esc and outside clicks close the panel; the button reopens it
hiding the floating button keeps the panel reachable programmatically (popup / toolbar)
